title: chat-server: pin and mention_broadcast gates skip channel overrides
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Space Permission Resolution L1619: 'When determining whether a member may perform an action in a channel Chat, servers MUST evaluate permissions in this order' (role deny/allow, member deny/allow). MemoryBackend may_set_pinned_messages and may_broadcast_mention use caller_effective_permissions (Space-level union only), so a channel permissionOverrides deny/allow of pin or mention_broadcast is ignored. JMAP-y3f2.1 added permissions::resolve_channel_permissions and memory.rs owner_channel_permissions; reuse them. may_broadcast_mention takes space_id only, so it needs a chat_id parameter (breaking ChatBackend change, pre-0.4 freeze JMAP-lrgt). Found while implementing JMAP-y3f2.1.
